gaps.explanation: The only page (p1, 2025 Audit Waiver Request, Summary Statement of Actual Cash Receipts, Disbursements, and Balances, 10/01/2024 to 4/15/2025; village unincorporated 1/1/2025) prints a single column headed 'Total of All Funds': Personal and Real Property Taxes 427.41 + State Receipts 3,667.43 + Local Receipts 28,933.90 = 33,028.74 = statement receipts. No individual fund column is printed and the rules forbid detail lines from the Total column, so no line can be added. Needs the user's decision whether a single 'Total of All Funds' column may be used as the village's one fund (it would add exactly the three lines above).

p1 'Total of All Funds' column only: Operating Expenses 27,511.71 + Other Capital Outlay 6,632.60 = 34,144.31 = statement disbursements. No fund column printed; nothing added (same reason as revenue).

p1 line 24 Transfers Between Funds Out 9,159.06 in the 'Total of All Funds' column (Inter-fund Transfers: From Lamar To Chase County Treasurer 9,159.06: remaining balance remitted on dissolution). No fund column printed; nothing added (same reason as revenue).
